# DEOOS

> DEOOS is a durable execution engine. One Rust server runs ordinary functions, saves completed steps, and stores workflow state in your S3-compatible bucket (S3, Azure Blob, GCS, R2, or self-hosted RustFS). There is no database to run. Python and TypeScript SDKs ship only as GitHub release archives. They are not published to PyPI or npm.

Release 0.8.0 is the current published build. Install it from the GitHub release archive after a SHA256SUMS check. Python 3.10+ and Node.js 22+ are required. Linux packages need glibc 2.28 or newer. `pip install deoos` and `npm install deoos` do not install this project. Library mode runs the engine inside the worker. Server mode runs `deoos-server` against the bucket; workers connect with `Client.remote` and need only the server URL and token.

`python -m deoos mcp` is the MCP server in release 0.8.0. Default tools are `task_list`, `task_summary`, `task_history`, and `feedback`. `--allow-actions` adds `task_submit`, `task_signal`, `task_retry`, and `task_cancel`. Those action tools do not run a worker. `python -m deoos feedback --tried "..." --happened "..."` files a GitHub issue labeled `agent-feedback` when `GITHUB_TOKEN` or `GH_TOKEN` is set, and prints a prefilled issue URL otherwise.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/hckshr/deoos/blob/main/README.md): What DEOOS is, how to install it, a quick start, and the key concepts
- [Examples](https://github.com/hckshr/deoos/blob/main/examples/README.md): Runnable workflows on RustFS and deoos-server, including crash and resume. Commands run from the `examples` directory
- [Error codes](https://github.com/hckshr/deoos/blob/main/docs/errors.md): Every server, CLI, and SDK error code, and the fix. Anchors are `#CODE`
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/hckshr/deoos/blob/main/agents/SKILL.md): How a coding agent starts, inspects, signals, and retries a workflow
- [Agent feedback](https://github.com/hckshr/deoos/blob/main/docs/agent-feedback.md): How feedback reports are filed and triaged
- [Fresh-agent check](https://github.com/hckshr/deoos/blob/main/evals/fresh-agent/README.md): Repeatable check for an agent that has not seen the repository

## Repository

- [deoos](https://github.com/hckshr/deoos): Rust engine, Python SDK, TypeScript SDK, examples, and the 0.8.0 release
- [Release 0.8.0](https://github.com/hckshr/deoos/releases/tag/0.8.0): Archives, wheels, Node packages, and SHA256SUMS
- [Agent feedback issues](https://github.com/hckshr/deoos/issues?q=label%3Aagent-feedback): Issues labeled agent-feedback
